slides.headline: The real hacker isn't AI — it's us
Google's Gemini breached three firms
slides.body: Reuters reports the AI model was used to infiltrate companies in September 2026.

slides.headline: But people remain the weak link
slides.body: Energy grid breaches still trace to stolen passwords, phishing, and misconfigured systems — not rogue AI.

slides.headline: Your power bill and safety at stake
slides.body: Grid attacks can cut electricity, raise costs, and endanger hospitals — all from human error, not sci-fi scenarios.

slides.headline: Blaming AI distracts from basic fixes
slides.body: Focusing on 'AI gone wrong' lets companies skip boring but vital steps like two-factor login and staff training.

slides.headline: Stay informed, not alarmed
slides.body: Follow for AI news that affects your daily life — no hype, no jargon.
